description: Is this crypto token safe? Use whenever a user or agent asks if a token is a scam, rug pull or honeypot, or before buying, swapping, approving or listing a token on Base (0x ERC-20) or Solana (mint). Returns a grade SAFE / CAUTION / RISKY / DANGER, a 0-100 score and plain-English reasons from live on-chain contract checks (upgradeable proxy, active owner, mint/blacklist/pause functions; Solana mint/freeze authority, top holders) plus DEX liquidity, 24h volume, buys/sells, price change and pair age. Input: {tokenAddress, chain?} (chain auto-detected). Typical latency 1-3 s. Not financial advice. Costs $0.008 USDC per call via x402 (Base preferred, or Solana); no charge on errors. Free tier: pass free_trial=true (10 calls/day). Example output: {"chain":"base","grade":"CAUTION","score":79,"one_liner":"Active owner can pause/blacklist transfers","reasons":["has an active owner","pausable transfers","capped at CAUTION: an active owner can pause or blacklist transfers (your sell could be blocked)"],"token":{"name":"Degen","symbol":"DEGEN","decimals":18},"market":{"pools":30,"liquidity_usd":261202,"volume_24h_usd":48000,"buys_24h":900,"sells_24h":850,"oldest_pair_age_days":900}}

free_trial.description: set true to use the free tier (10 calls/day) without payment

tokenAddress.description: Base 0x token contract or Solana mint

x402_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload; omit to receive payment requirements
